answer: Sybil resistance can come from auctioning a scarce number of admission slots each epoch, paid with a locked ferrous reserve that can be withdrawn only after several epochs of unique attested work. Emissions move as a river through those slots alone. An orchard of established auditors re-executes a random sample of the work; a mismatch slashes the reserve and burns the slot. A farm must therefore win many scarce slots and risk metal-backed capital, so extra identities cost more than they return.
